played in the normal fashion. e.g. cards brought out by disguised weapon and
vast wealth however it doesn't mention charming lobby specifically. Can you
DI the vote called by charming lobby? If so, what happens to the charming
lobby action? Is that the end of the action? Will the next vote still pass
automatically?

>>>so, what happens to the charming lobby action? Is that the end of the
>>>action? Will the next vote still pass automatically?
>>
>>No. Moot. Moot. Moot.

Let me elaborate on this. If I am the player that holds
the Direct Intervention, do I have to play it before the
acting minion designates which Political Action
is tied to the Charming Lobby?

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
>===== Original Message From berni...@aol.com (BernieTime) =====

>>Can you DI the vote called by charming lobby?

>>>No.

>
>Let me elaborate on this. If I am the player that holds
>the Direct Intervention, do I have to play it before the
>acting minion designates which Political Action
>is tied to the Charming Lobby?

You cannot. The referendum to be called is declared when
the card is played. The player playing Charming Lobby
must declare the action (per the rules). You can then
play DI on the Charming Lobby.
